system.description:
ARCANE FOCUS LIGHT RYUKARI SAVE TECHNIQUE

The celestial radiance within your blood erupts from your scales and eyes, briefly revealing something of the majesty of the dragons from which your lineage descends.

Action 2 AP; Area 10-foot emanation

Saving Throw Reflex against your Level DC

You release a sudden flare of celestial light. You may exclude any number of allies from the effect.

Critical the target is unaffected.

Success the target is dazzled until the beginning of its next turn.

Partial the target is dazzled until the end of its next turn.

Failure the target is dazzled for 1 minute.

Fumble the target is blinded until the beginning of its next turn and is then dazzled for 1 minute.

Automated: press Use: 2 AP and its Focus use. Every creature within 10 feet other than your allies makes a Reflex save against your Level DC (your allies are left out, as the book allows), and the ladder is applied: dazzled for a round, two rounds or 1 minute; on a Fumble blinded for a round and dazzled for 1 minute.
system.traits: Arcane, Focus, Light, Ryukari, Save, Technique
